results.title: Floating nuclear power plant 'has boosted air quality'
results.content: An environmental monitoring report for Russia's floating nuclear power plant suggests that emissions have fallen almost 80% since it started supplying heating in the area in 2022.

results.title: Nuclear fuel delivered for Bangladesh's second unit
results.content: Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom says that the initial fuel load for Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant's second unit has been delivered.

results.title: Turkish oil refiner to consider SMR deployment
results.content: TÜPRAŞ, Turkey's largest crude oil refiner, has signed an agreement with the US Trade and Development Agency to fund technical assistance to assess the potential of small modular reactors to supply electricity, heat and steam for its refining processes.

results.title: Westinghouse to conduct key study for AP1000 in Slovakia
results.content: Westinghouse is to carry out a Front-End Engineering and Design study for the potential deployment of an AP1000 reactor at the Bohunice Nuclear Power Plant in the Slovak Republic.

results.title: Uganda and Russia look to move ahead with nuclear project
results.content: A roadmap setting out cooperation in the peaceful uses of nuclear energy, as part of work towards a nuclear power plant, has been signed by Russia and Uganda.

results.title: Texas SMR plant moves to final permitting stage
results.content: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission says there will soon be a construction permit announcement after it finished its safety review for the Xe-100 reactor, which is proposed for deployment at the Long Mott Generating Station in Texas.

results.title: First concrete poured for unit 5 at Haiyang plant
results.content: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 5 at the Haiyang nuclear power plant. It is the fifth of six large pressurised water reactors planned for the site in China's Shandong province.

results.title: PEJ applies for early works permit for nuclear power plant
results.content: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has applied to the head of the Pomeranian Voivodeship for a permit to start early works required for the construction of Poland's first nuclear power plant at the Lubiatowo-Kopalino site in the Choczewo municipality.

results.title: Singapore enlists Finnish help in bolstering nuclear expertise
results.content: The VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland and the Singapore Nuclear Research and Safety Institute have signed a five-year memorandum of understanding to deepen cooperation in nuclear safety and strengthen the capabilities required to assess emerging nuclear technologies.

results.title: Turkey and South Korea explore nuclear financing cooperation
results.content: A framework to evaluate potential cooperation on the financing of nuclear power projects was one of a number of energy-related initiatives agreed between Turkey and South Korea.

results.title: Saltfoss targets US licensing for floating power plant
results.content: Molten Salt Power Barge developer Saltfoss has notified the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission of its intent to begin pre-application engagement.

results.title: Initial fuel loading completed at second San'ao unit
results.content: The loading of fuel assemblies into the core of unit 2 at the San'ao nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province has been completed ahead of its start up. The unit is the second of six HPR1000s (Hualong Ones) planned at the site.

results.title: Helen to assess environmental impacts of SMR in Helsinki
results.content: Finland's Helen Ydinvoima Oy has launched an environmental impact assessment on the construction of a small nuclear power plant at one of three potential sites in Helsinki.

results.title: IHI to supply components for first Polish AP1000
results.content: Japanese engineering firm IHI Corporation has received an order from Westinghouse covering engineering and procurement activities for long-lead items for one containment vessel and an associated large steel module for the first unit of Poland's first nuclear power plant.

results.title: Reactor components completed for El Dabaa 1
results.content: All the key components have now been manufactured for the first unit’s reactor at Egypt's El Dabaa Nuclear Power Plant.

results.title: X-energy selects Fluor for second Xe-100 project
results.content: Fluor Corporation is to provide design and engineering services to support the second-of-a-kind US project featuring X-energy's Xe-100, at Energy Northwest's proposed Cascade Advanced Energy Facility near Richland, Washington.

results.title: Calogena awarded EU funding for SMR deployment
results.content: French small modular reactor developer Calogena has been awarded EUR40 million (USD44.6 million) through the European Commission's Innovation Fund to support the potential construction of its first commercial nuclear reactor in Pierrelatte, in southern France.

results.title: Construction of Chinese HTGR begins
results.content: The first batch of concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of the high-temperature gas-cooled reactor that forms part of the initial phase of the Jiangsu Xuwei Nuclear Heating and Power Plant, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

results.title: Concrete work completed for Akkuyu 4's turbine unit
results.content: More than 2,240 cubic metres of concrete was used to complete the turbine building foundation for Turkey's Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant's fourth unit.

results.title: Estonia narrows search for nuclear power plant location
results.content: The search for a site for Estonia's first nuclear power plant will now focus on three locations, all in the municipality of Viru-Nigula, about 120 kilometres east of Tallin, after three locations in Lüganuse municipality were ruled out for security reasons.

results.title: Fourth Hualong One under construction at San'ao site
results.content: The first concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 4 of the San'ao nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province, China General Nuclear has announced.

results.title: Game of Thrones actor aims to highlight Chernobyl's need for international support
results.content: Danish actor and United Nations Goodwill Ambassador Nikolaj Coster-Waldau has visited the Chernobyl nuclear power plant site, for a project which "aims to draw international attention to the need for support in restoring the New Safe Confinement, protecting the environment and ensuring radiation safety".

results.title: Cernavoda units remain shut down due to Danube water levels
results.content: Romania's Nuclearelectrica says that although there has been a recent rise in the local water level in the River Danube, current forecasts do not yet support a decision to restart the units.

results.title: Algae early-warning system aims to offer safety, operational benefits
results.content: An AI-based system has been developed to anticipate the arrival of floating vegetation masses at the cooling system of the Ascó Nuclear Power Plant in Spain, and is a significant advance on traditional visual inspection methods, say its creators, GDES and plant operator ANAV.

results.title: ASNR opens passive safety system testing facility
results.content: France's nuclear safety regulator has inaugurated new research infrastructure and facilities at its Cadarache site for studying the reliability of passive safety systems. It aims to generate the scientific knowledge necessary for the independent safety assessment of innovative reactors and small modular reactors.

results.title: Cernavodă units returning to operation after three months
results.content: Nuclearelectrica and the Romanian government are working on long-term solutions to avoid a repeat of the Cernavodă units being shut down because of drought causing abnormally low water levels in the Danube.

results.title: US issues landmark construction permit for Texas SMR plant
results.content: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued a construction permit for the proposed plant featuring four Xe-100 small modular reactor units at Dow's Seadrift site - the first construction permit for a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor issued in the USA in nearly 60 years.

results.title: Belgian nuclear power plant negotiations extended
results.content: The Belgian state, Engie and Electrabel have agreed to postpone to 12 December the target date for the conclusion of the heads of terms for the potential acquisition of Belgium's seven nuclear power reactors by the state.

results.title: Canadian budget sets out nuclear investments
results.content: The budget released by the Canadian government provides funding for a strategy to double grid capacity by 2050, as well as investments in nuclear energy and critical minerals.

results.title: US government loan to support Constellation uprates
results.content: US utility Constellation has secured a conditional loan commitment of up to USD5 billion from the Department of Energy's Office of Energy Dominance Financing towards uprates and modernisation projects across its nuclear power reactor fleet in Illinois, Maryland, and Pennsylvania.
